The showdown between "BNW" brought immense 
excitement to this race. The one who 
emerged victorious was Winning Ticket.

Driven by the wish to run an awesome race 
with the two of them again, she sets her 
next goal on the Osaka Hai, where they're 
both likely to run.

However, Narita Taishin and Biwa Hayahide 
calmly watched Winning Ticket.
